title: Exec scenario matrix and briefing kit for Q2 investment gates
creator: Priya Rao
description: Produce an exec-facing briefing kit including a scenario matrix (best/likely/worst), recommended investment asks per scenario, and a slide deck + one-pager for the Q2 investment gates review. The kit should synthesize product roadmap options, cost/latency implications, SLO risk, and OKR alignment. Coordinate with Eng for data pulls (latency percentiles, infra cost trends, capacity forecasts) and Design for deck templates.
acceptance_criteria: Slide deck (15-20 slides) reviewed by PM leadership
One-page executive summary with clear ask amounts and success metrics
Scenario matrix with quantitative thresholds for each column
Linked data dashboards for key metrics (latency, cost, incidents)
Deck uploaded to Drive + Confluence PRD with decision table

decisions: Adopt three-scenario format (Best/Likely/Worst) with quantitative thresholds by metric (cost delta %, 99p latency ms, incident rate).
Include a default fallback ask tier (medium) plus optional stretch ask to be used only if SLAs/risk require.
Use Dedicated capacity pricing for conservative cost modeling; include hosted API sensitivity in appendix.
